config:
version: 1
project:
  name: immutability-helper
test:
  framework: jest
  cwd: .
  env: {}
baseline: {}
targets:
  mode: auto
  include:
    - index.ts
  exclude: []
  depth: direct
  declared: []
  remove: []
inputs:
  hints: []
  skip: []
  values: {}
mutations:
  mode: quick
  seed: 7
  combine: false
  per_target: {}
  limits:
    total_mutations: 120
    string_length: 10000
    array_length: 1000
    object_depth: 20
    memory_mb: 512
execution:
  timeout_ms: 15000
  parallelism: 1
  isolation: process
  warn_after_ms: 1800000
  max_output_bytes: 8388608
  reset:
    environment: true
    mocks: true
    database: none
    filesystem: none
oracle:
  handled_errors: []
  crash_errors:
    - TypeError
    - ReferenceError
    - RangeError
  suspicious_accept: report
redaction:
  fields:
    - password
    - token
    - apiKey
    - authorization
    - cookie
    - secret
    - privateKey
  patterns: []
  store_raw_values: false
storage:
  location: user
  retention_runs: 50
integrity:
  watch_ignored: false
  ignore_for_integrity: []
cache:
  enabled: false
ci:
  fail_on:
    - CRASH
    - TIMEOUT
  fail_on_regression: true
  include_transitive: false
acceptances: []
